title: Six disjoint blocks counted by a multinomial coefficient
statement: Let $n,d\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $6d\le n$. The number of ways to choose six ordered, pairwise disjoint subsets of size $d$ from an $n$-element set is the multinomial coefficient with six parts of size $d$ and one remaining part of size $n-6d$.
